notes: Own-harness run through the harness's own engine with the observer wrapped around its default model runner.

Model route anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 resolves to the claude CLI under the local claude.ai login. Haiku is the deliberate choice for routine pilot runs: this workload is a pipeline exercise, not a model comparison, so the cheapest capable route is the right one.
Per-call cost is not metered on this path and is recorded as unknown. llm_max_files bounds how many files reach the model; raise it only for a run whose purpose needs it.
Keep the input list small. Adding repositories multiplies model calls with no gain until the existing cases carry reviewed labels.
qmd is absent on this machine, so the harness reports a lite runtime profile and marks the run degraded.
Content-mode traces stay local; they contain the source that was sent to the model.
